items.title: Watch out for Brentford’s Sangare - he could be signing of the season
items.description: It's September 2024, and Mamadou Sangare has been called up to the Mali squad for the very first time. As is normal in modern football, new players have to do an initiation song while stood on top of a chair.

items.title: Sky Sports and The Fast and the Curious announce new partnership
items.description: Sky Sports and The Fast and the Curious have announced a new long-term strategic partnership, ahead of Formula 1's return to action this weekend with the Dutch Grand Prix.

items.title: Ex-Australian star Warner convicted and fined after drink driving
items.description: Former Australia batsman David Warner has been fined A$1,500 (£787) and ordered to have an interlock device on his car for 12 months after being convicted for drink driving.

items.title: Pep reduced to tears prepping Man City farewell speech in new doc footage
items.description: In a new Prime Video documentary 'A Beautiful Obsession', behind-the-scenes footage shows Pep Guardiola breaking down in tears prepping his Manchester City leaving speech. Video credit: Prime Video

items.title: Is Haaland worth the price? Pick Rogers or Palmer? Five key FPL questions
items.description: BBC Sport's team of Fantasy Premier League experts debate some of the new season's big talking points to help you select your team before Friday's deadline.

items.title: Could refreshed Odegaard be like a new signing?
items.description: The Arsenal captain had a hugely frustrating 2025-26 season despite leading his team to the title - but now appears fit and refreshed.

items.title: 'Nothing's eternal' Pep opens up on time at Man City in NEW documentary
items.description: In a new new Prime Video documentary, 'A Beautiful Obsession', Pep Guardiola opens up about his time at Manchester City. Video credit: Prime Video

items.title: Ex-Man Utd striker Depay takes pay cut to stay at Corinthians
items.description: Memphis Depay waives a reported fee of nearly £3m days after accusing Corinthians of "unacceptable behaviour" over a contract extension.

items.title: Australia make big batting change after shock Bangladesh loss
items.description: Australia have dropped opener Jake Weatherald after their shock home loss to Bangladesh but retained Marnus Labuschagne for the must-win second Test.

items.title: Hatate rejects Celtic exit options - gossip
items.description: Celtic midfielder rejects transfer approaches as Rangers close in on deal for right-back from Premier League...

items.title: Williams sisters lose tie-break thriller in first doubles reunion since 2022
items.description: Serena and Venus Williams were narrowly beaten in their first doubles match together in four years during a dramatic first-round tie-break exit at the Cincinnati Open.

items.title: Haaland's main rivals for the Premier League Golden Boot
items.description: Erling Haaland will hope for a record-equalling fourth Golden Boot this season - but who could challenge him as the Premier League's top-scorer?
